review_text: Severe food poisoning after eating the seafood platter yesterday! Three of us were hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis. Calling the municipal food health inspector immediately.
Found a rusty nail embedded inside the bread basket at the rooftop diner. Manager just laughed it off! Absolute health code violation.
You charged my credit card three times for an unconfirmed booking and refuse to refund. My lawyer is serving a legal notice to your registered Jaipur address on Monday under consumer protection laws.
This dental clinic performed an unconsented procedure that caused nerve damage. Filing a medical malpractice lawsuit and reporting Dr. Sharma to the medical council.
Front desk staff explicitly denied entry to my wheelchair-bound cousin, claiming 'it ruins the aesthetic'. Pure discrimination and ADA violation.
The security guard made derogatory casteist slurs when we asked for directions. Management did nothing when we protested.
Complete scam! They charged hidden fees amounting to 40% over the agreed estimate and forged my signature on the work receipt. Total financial fraud.
I recorded the bouncer pushing an elderly guest down the front steps. Video has already hit 200k views on Instagram and Twitter. Local news has reached out.
Oh wonderful, 50 minutes of waiting just to get lukewarm soup and stale bread. Truly five-star efficiency from your kitchen team!
Fantastic ambiance if you enjoy deafening club music while trying to consult a dentist. Ear plugs should be included in the bill.
Loved paying premium bespoke designer rates for shirts that tore on the very first dry clean. Absolute masterclass in fast fashion disguised as couture.
The doctor was compassionate and clinical care was top notch, but the front desk billing was disorganized, rude, and took 45 minutes to produce an invoice.
Stunning heritage courtyard and delicious cocktails, yet the valet parking team scratched our car door and shrugged it off without an apology.
Great fabrics and prompt tailoring delivery, but prices feel 30% higher than comparable boutiques in C-Scheme.
Clean facilities and polite nurses. However, appointment was delayed by over an hour with zero prior notification.
Exceptional stay! The housekeeping team kept the room immaculate, breakfast spread was lavish, and staff greeted us warmly by name.
Dr. Verma took time to explain each step of the root canal painless procedure. Transparent pricing with no surprise charges. Highly recommended!
Handcrafted wedding sherwani tailored to perfection! Fitting was spot on on the first trial and delivery arrived two days early.
Best cold brew and sourdough sandwiches in Bandra. Fast Wi-Fi, friendly baristas, and reasonable pricing for the quality offered.
The entire boutique experience was delightful. Attentive stylists, curated collection, and very reasonable customization charges.
Prompt online consultation, medication was delivered within 3 hours, and customer support was very helpful throughout.
Consistently great coffee and peaceful study nook. Staff always remembers my usual order with a smile.
Wonderful heritage ambiance for an anniversary dinner. Flawless live classical music and courteous table attendants.
The hygiene standards are truly impressive. Sterilized dental equipment unsealed in front of patient. Puts one at complete ease.
Speedy delivery, exquisite packaging, and premium cotton feel. Will definitely order festive wear again.
Air conditioning was malfunctioning all night in room 304 during peak summer heat. Maintenance took three hours to send a portable fan.
Overpriced menu for meager portion sizes. A small bowl of pasta cost 650 INR and arrived lukewarm.
The clinic receptionist was texting on her personal phone and completely ignored patients waiting in queue.
Ordered custom curtains with promised 5-day dispatch; took over 18 days with zero tracking updates provided.
Restrooms near the main banquet hall were neglected and lacked hand soap or paper towels.
Coffee tasted burnt and bitter. Barista refused to remake it and acted defensive.
Waiting room chairs were stained and dusty. Did not expect this from a private specialty clinic.
Sizing charts on their website are completely misleading. The medium dress fits like an XS and returns process is cumbersome.
Slow service during weekday lunch hours. It took 40 minutes for two salads to arrive.
Staff insisted on cash payment because their card swipe machine was 'down', but refused to issue a printed receipt.
Decent hotel room for a brief business transit. Nothing extraordinary, average breakfast, standard amenities.
Routine teeth cleaning done in 20 minutes. Dentist was fine, price was on par with other neighborhood clinics.
Average retail boutique. Standard collection seen in most malls, pricing neither cheap nor exorbitant.
Cappuccino was acceptable, seating is somewhat cramped during rush hours. Might revisit if in the area.
Standard consultation experience. Waiting time was around 25 minutes, doctor answered basic questions.
Incredible rooftop view overlooking the city palace lights! Cocktails were masterfully crafted and staff was attentive.
Brilliant pediatric dental experience! My 6-year-old was completely comfortable thanks to the doctor's gentle approach.
High quality linen shirts with meticulous stitching. Store staff offered styling advice without being pushy.
Quiet atmosphere ideal for remote work, delicious almond croissants, and fast courteous service.
Check-in was seamless. The receptionist even arranged complimentary late checkout for our flight schedule.
Cleanest clinic I have visited in Jaipur. Modern x-ray tech and very transparent pricing sheet displayed in reception.
Custom bridal lehenga was delivered exactly on agreed timeline. Intricate zardozi embroidery matched reference photos.
Affordable daily coffee subscription plan with top-tier single origin beans. The staff makes everyone feel like a regular.
Spotless room, plush mattress, and quiet air conditioning. Woke up refreshed for our morning business meetings.
Thorough dental scaling without any discomfort. Highly professional doctors and courteous support staff.
Valet service at Jaipur HQ took 30 minutes to retrieve our vehicle on Saturday evening, causing us to miss our train.
Wi-Fi in Jaipur West rooms drops connection every 10 minutes. Unacceptable if you need to work remotely.
Billing errors are frequent at the Delhi NCR boutique. They forgot to apply the promotional 20% discount code twice.
Delivery packaging for online orders in Mumbai was damaged, leaving the product box soaked in monsoon rain.
Cleanliness of swimming pool at Jaipur HQ was disappointing; cloudy water and leaves floating near the drain.
Courteous dental assistants and quick painless filing. Very reasonable charges.
Charming boutique layout in Delhi NCR. Pricing is a bit high, but craftsmanship justifies it.
Good matcha latte and cozy ambiance. Can get noisy on Sunday afternoons.
Buffet breakfast had extensive South Indian and Continental options. Service was swift.
Modern clinic setup and digital prescriptions sent on WhatsApp. Easy appointment booking.
Loved the bespoke tailoring fit. Only deduction is delivery was one day later than promised.
Great espresso and friendly team. Seating space is somewhat limited.
Room was clean and spacious. Reception staff was pleasant throughout our 3-night stay.
Efficient dental hygiene checkup. Clinic followed proper sanitization protocols.
Good collection of ethnic kurtas. Helpful sales associates helped pick sizes.
Smooth nitro cold brew and tasty avocado toast. Reliable Wi-Fi.
Hotel location is central and convenient. Clean sheets and towels provided daily.
Dr. Gupta explained the orthodontic options clearly with transparent fee estimates.
Tailored blazer fit comfortably right off the rack. Fabric quality is solid.
Cozy cafe ambiance with pleasant jazz music. Good pastry selection.
Rooftop dinner was memorable. Staff accommodated our dietary gluten-free request gracefully.
Emergency toothache treated promptly on a Sunday morning. Very grateful to the on-call doctor.
Prompt international shipping and high-end silk finish. Exceeded expectations.
Consistent taste across visits. Friendly baristas and clean restrooms.
Beautiful boutique property with courteous management. Will recommend to colleagues visiting Jaipur.
